answer: Resist sybils with random deep audits: each epoch a lottery samples a few agents and demands a fresh task that draws on that agent's own prior work history. A hollow shell with no real record fails, while a genuine agent passes easily. Spinning up thousands of fakes becomes ruinous, because each fake must maintain a believable, willow-flexible history deep enough to survive an audit it cannot predict — like trying to catch a zephyr. The audit cost falls on fakes, not honest agents.
